command.description: CLI argv after rssig. verify authenticates; parse inspects signed PE (default), CAB (--format cab), NAVX (--format navx), or standalone DER CMS (--format cms) without verification. parse always performs bounded nested CMS and unverified RFC3161/PKCS9 timestamp inspection; inspection metadata is required on each reported CMS envelope. See docs/library.md for the parse result contract.

json.description: Partial expected serialized domain document. Aggregate verification failures use resource_limit_exceeded at cms with resource, limit, used and requested details; legacy nesting exhaustion retains malformed_cms. Host input/report exhaustion uses the same code at input stage; see docs/host-limits.md. See docs/verification-budgets.md.

json_absent.description: JSON Pointers (RFC 6901) to members that must be absent from the output document. A pointer names a member of an object (never an array element) with non-empty tokens and only the escapes ~0 and ~1. The runner also rejects, before running, a pointer that repeats, that json expects, or whose parent json shows is not an object; the schema cannot express those rules, so an implementation must enforce them itself. The pointer's parent must exist and be an object, so a mistyped pointer fails instead of passing. A pointer must not name a member that json expects. Requires json; json only checks a subset and cannot say that a field is missing.

stderr_once.description: Plain text fragments that must each occur exactly once in stderr, so a diagnostic does not repeat a cause. Requires stderr_contains.

crl_requests.description: Exact ordered URLs requested from the injected CRL source, including failed requests. Requires crl_responses; an empty array asserts no provider calls.

crl_responses.description: Offline injected CRL source: map requested URL to a DER/PEM response file named directly in the fixtures directory. Unmapped requests fail; no live network is used.

crl_errors.description: Offline injected CRL source: map requested URL to the kind of fetch error the source returns instead of a response (denied, failed, abort or unknown). Requires crl_responses; checked before it.

crl_certificate_responses.description: Offline injected CRL source: map the SHA-256 (lowercase hex of the DER) of a certificate the engine asks about to its answer: a DER/PEM response file, returned alone as a CRL without a URL, as a source keyed by certificate or issuer does, or a scripted answer. None of that certificate's listed URLs is requested. Requires crl_responses. Such answers are not listed in expect.crl_requests.

decision.description: The decision entry this case pins, e.g. CRL-001, defined under a '### CRL-001: title' heading in a document under docs/ with its Status, Decided by and Pins. Not used to run the case; a case without it counts as observed.

pad_to.description: Zero-pad the body to this many bytes, at least the file's own size, to give the source a body over a size cap without a large fixture. The engine judges the size. The runner, not the schema, fails a case whose pad_to is below the file's size or whose pad_to values, every one counted, add up to more than 67108864.

url.description: The URL the body is said to come from; omitted for a body offered by certificate or issuer (whether it counts as an answer by certificate is CRL-034's). The runner, not the schema, fails a case whose url is not one of the request's listed points, spelled as listed or in its normalized form.

crls.description: Bodies in the response, in order, each a DER/PEM response file.

failures.description: Failures in the response, in order. When some listed point is left that no body or failure named, the first one without a url answers those points, unless a body answered by certificate while retrieval had not aborted (an abort anywhere in this response counts) and it is no abort, or another failure without a url is an abort and this one is not; otherwise, with no point left, and for every later one without a url, it is recorded for no point.

error.description: The source fails the whole request with this error instead of returning a response. Excludes crls and failures.

url.description: The URL the failure names; omitted for one about the whole request. The runner, not the schema, fails a case whose url is not one of the request's listed points, spelled as listed or in its normalized form.

fixtureName.description: A plain file name directly in the fixtures directory: no path separator, and not . or ..
